game_name: SNK vs. Capcom - SVC Chaos (JAMMA PCB, NEO-MVH MVO PCB)
general_issues: Select svcpcb.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
